flow-definition.description:
Publishes Apps on IIS
Parameters: CLIENT_ID APPS_ZIP_FILENAME BUILD_NUMBER MIN_DAYS MIN_BUILDS SEPARATE_APPS
Needed configurations: IISSERVER defined in Jenkins globals DEPLOY_PATH defined in Jenkins globals ZIPEXE defined in Jenkins globals REINDEX_CLIENT (exe client to be used to reindex DBs)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: APPS_ZIP_FILENAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Zip filename starting name with apps to be published

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MIN_DAYS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Minimum number of days before a build can be deleted

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MIN_BUILDS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Minimum number of builds to keep

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: SEPARATE_APPS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Place each app into a different zip file
